# 1 Clement Chapter 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 13 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_013_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 13

**13:1** So then, brothers and sisters — let us be humble. Let us put away every form of arrogance, self-importance, foolishness, and anger, and live by what is written. The Holy Spirit says: "Don't let the wise boast in their wisdom, the strong in their strength, the rich in their wealth. Let anyone who boasts, boast in the Lord — in seeking him and practicing justice and righteousness." [Jer 9:23-24] And above all, let us keep in mind what the Lord Jesus said when he taught gentleness and patience:

**13:2** "Show mercy — and you will receive mercy. Forgive — and you will be forgiven. What you do to others will be done to you. What you give will be given to you. How you judge others is how you will be judged. The kindness you show is the kindness you will receive. Whatever measure you use for others, that same measure will be used for you."

---

*PNEUMA: The saying-cluster in 13:2 is among the earliest attestations of Jesus' teaching outside the canonical Gospels. The chiastic structure is preserved.*
